description: A class providing web automation capabilities for login forms within a Flutter WebView environment, including field filling, captcha detection, captcha injection, and form submission, with configurable selectors and fallback strategies.

classes.name: WebAutomation
classes.description: Service class to automate web login processes via WebView, including input filling, captcha detection, captcha injection, and form submission, emitting progress and error streams.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes automation helpers by injecting bootstrap JavaScript for querying and setting input values.

methods.name: fillFields
methods.description: Fills username and password input fields based on configured selectors, using fallbacks if necessary.

methods.name: detectCaptcha
methods.description: Detects the presence of a captcha element on the page, emitting a notification if detected.

methods.name: injectCaptchaValue
methods.description: Injects a specified value into the captcha input element.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Attempts to submit the login form by clicking a submit button or calling form.submit().

methods.name: updateSelectors
methods.description: Updates CSS selectors for username, password, submit, and captcha elements at runtime.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes all stream controllers and cleans up resources.
